title: security: RBAC v2 + KMS region-residency enforcement and expanded audit logging
author: Jordan Kim
release_notes: Enforce KMS key region-residency checks for RBAC v2 policies; add detailed audit events for KMS usage and region-pinning decisions; include migration helper and opt-in flag for staged rollout.
description: Motivation: customers in regulated industries require both enforcement of KMS region residency and auditability for any cross-region KMS operations. This PR implements enforcement hooks into RBAC v2 policy evaluation to ensure KMS-backed secrets and keys respect configured region-residency constraints, and expands audit logging to surface KMS key selection, region-pin decisions, and fallback events. Changes include policy enforcement, audit schema additions, migration helpers, tests, and docs. Checklist: [x] implement enforcement logic; [x] add audit events and schema migration; [x] add unit + integration tests; [x] provide migration/rollout notes; [x] update RBAC docs and admin console messaging; [x] add metrics for dropped/allowed requests. Rollout plan: feature gated behind config "enforce_kms_region_residency" (default false) and will be enabled for internal staging for 1 week before enabling for customers. See ENG-1189 for design notes and SUP-10234 for customer support context.

review_comments: Marta Lopez: Can we add a short-circuit path for high-throughput tokenization calls so we don't pay audit serialization cost on every token generation? Suggest using sampled audit events for noisy paths.
Jordan Kim (author): Good point - added metric and sampling config; heavy generation paths will emit sampled audit events and full payloads for policy decisions only. See commit t6u7v8w.
Ethan Zhao: Need clarity on fallback semantics: if primary KMS region is unavailable, do we ever auto-fallback to global key? This must be explicit in policy and audit info.
Jordan Kim: Fallback controlled by policy attribute 'allow_global_fallback'. If false, request denied and audit records reason=fallback_disabled. Documented in docs/ops.
Priya Narayanan: Tests look good; please add one more case for partially-matched policy conditions (multiple keys with mixed regions) and ensure deterministic selection order.
Jordan Kim: Added deterministic selection (prefer same-region, then explicitly pinned keys, then fallback if allowed) and unit test case in p3q4r5s commit.
Marta Lopez: Approving after small nits fixed in docs and added a note to migration that large audit tables may need reindexing.
